name: corpus-saves-preview-listed
description: test.md 'Whether the WE treats war3mapPreview.tga as a map file': flat.w3x with a war3mapPreview.tga that war3map.imp names (flags 29): both saves keep file and entry. Without the entry (make-corpus-saves.mjs preview-unlisted) the editor's save drops the file and Studio's keeps it, which a spec can't hold (a file missing from one save is never the expected difference): the editor treats it as an import, lib/imports.ts isMapFile
